title: Using dominance over subjugation
body:
Using dominance over subjugation
There are two types of dominance: one is dominance driven by the desire to dominate, and the other is resistance to being dominated by others and the act of counter-dominance.

title: Accepting critical voices
body:
Accepting critical voices
Mushrooms have a special fondness for dark, damp and poorly ventilated places, and they grow and multiply there.
The same is true for human organizations and groups. If they are constantly in an environment that cannot accommodate critical voices and is extremely closed, the forces of corruption and degeneration will surely rise and expand.
Criticism is not doubt or unreasonable opinions. Criticism is like a gentle breeze brushing against the face. Although it feels cold, it can suppress the reproduction of evil bacteria. Therefore, we should accept critical voices.

title: If your ideas differ from those of the organization, don't consider it abnormal.
body:
If your ideas differ from those of the organization, don't consider it abnormal.
Those who think more and more profoundly than others are not suitable to stay in the organization or join factions. This is because such people will unconsciously go beyond the interests of the organization and the faction, and thus engage in deeper and broader thinking.
Organizations and factions impose a framework on people's thinking, which is like stringing together a considerable number of fruits, or like those things that keep a group of small fish swimming together.
Therefore, if your ideas are incompatible with those of the organization, there is no need to consider yourself abnormal. It is simply because your thoughts have already transcended this narrow world of the organization and reached a broader realm.

title: There is no need to be afraid of loneliness.
body:
There is no need to be afraid of loneliness.
Most people lose their purity by relying on social interactions or communicating with others, and then they become more humble.
Therefore, we should make ourselves more resilient. Don't be easily influenced or swayed by others' opinions or interpersonal relationships. We should maintain our true selves.
In this regard, what can help us is the purity, bravery and insight that we have abandoned. With their help, we can remain independent in the torrent of the world.
And don't be afraid of loneliness. Instead of being afraid of it, it's better to fully experience the pleasure of being alone.

title: Superman is the Earth
body:
Superman is the Earth
Superman is the Earth. Therefore, you must be faithful to the Earth. Do not blindly trust those who think they can surpass the Earth. Whether intentionally or unintentionally, they are all poisonous people. They are already in a critical state and have disgusted the Earth. So let them do as they please! In the past, insulting God would result in severe punishment. But now that God is dead, this crime no longer exists. However, the act of insulting the Earth is equally sinful!

title: Become a Superhuman
body:
Become a Superhuman
Chalaturistra arrived in a small town, which was closest to the forest. At that time, many people were gathering in the market, waiting to watch a performance by a rope walker.
Chalaturistra said to the crowd:
"You yourselves should become superhumans. Humans should constantly surpass themselves. This is the trend of development. You surely wouldn't want to return to the state of beasts, would you?"
"Although quite a lot of people have gone through the process from beasts to humans, in essence, they are still beasts. Even the most intelligent ones are merely a mixture of plants and ghosts! Therefore, I will teach you to become superhumans! To be true humans!"

title: Things have no distinction between surface and interior
body:
Things have no distinction between surface and interior.
We are accustomed to categorizing the things we see, which is due to our certain thinking patterns. In other words, we are accustomed to extracting the basic forms of things from their origins.
However, if we do not artificially process these things but simply observe them openly, we will find that there is no such thing as form at all.
Why is that? The reason is that all things have no distinction between surface and interior. They are interconnected both on the surface and within. Moreover, neither the surface nor the interior has any so-called fundamental form.
